difficulty_reason: Prove Hilb^d x_S X -> Hilb^{d+1} is finite locally free of degree d+1 when the Hilb functors are representable: consider the universal divisor D_univ on Hilb^{d+1} x X and the map (D', x) |-> (D' + x, x) from Hilb^d x_S X into D_univ; prove it is an isomorphism: a T-point of D_univ is a pair (D, x) with D of degree d+1 containing the graph of x; by lemma-difference-divisors-on-curves write D = D' + x with D' of degree d; the assignment (D, x) |-> (D', x) is the inverse.
